December was another solid month for the US stock market, with the S&P 500 yielding 4.4% and the tech-heavy NASDAQ Composite an even better 5.5%.

The positive performance also pushed the Dow Jones Industrial Average to a record closing high of $37,710 on December 28th, cementing the best year for stocks since 2021.
